attributes.note_text: Drives the audible/visual alarm. Alarm level must stay within L_alarm_min..L_alarm_max and bearing/distance output must be correct for evasive action.
Performs the tiger/non-tiger classification — the highest-criticality SW component in the detection chain. Classification insufficiency is the dominant SOTIF concern.
Top-level application state machine. Owns safe-state transition and start/stop sequencing; must reach safe state within T_warning on fault detection.
Primary visual sensing path. Frame timing and fault signalling are safety-relevant; missing/stuck frames must be detectable by downstream consumers (ASIL B).
Provides LiDAR and IR sensor data. Degradation must be detected within T_sensor_degradation and propagated to the fusion layer.
